answer: An attacker who spins up a thousand fake identities must post stake for each, and since rewards per epoch follow the same curve, splitting stake across many sybils yields less than one honest node. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must forge a bond of copper tokens locked for several epochs, and voting weight scales with the square root of stake. A dune of cheap throwaway keys gains no traction, because peers only attest to identities backed by real locked value. This model fits agent Agent0171's threat model.
